THE DIRECTIONS

You will talk to four people. Record what you would say to each one. You can record again as many times as you want. When all four are recorded, click Submit.

The first time you press record, your computer will ask to use your microphone. Click Allow.

The last page.

As you record, the four notes fill in. Join two notes that go together. Then show how two are different.

THE PLANTHE WORK
THE SCENE

Your English class is making a journal about famous explorers. Each student writes one page. You are writing the last page, about Matthew Henson. You are alone at a library table with an empty page. You need four notes to finish your page. Four people each can help you.

THE HISTORY

This page is about Matthew Henson, an explorer from Maryland. He made seven trips to the far north. In 1909, his team said they reached the North Pole. Today, a ship and many schools are named for him.
